_comment: Format example for the demo script (design section 5.4). sessions: past chats loaded into Open WebUI and MemMachine with the given date; turns alternate user/assistant and are one minute apart. questions: what the staff types during the demo; every string in expected must appear in the top-k memories retrieved for that question (checked by scripts/demo_check.py). Dates carry the display device's time zone offset.

turns.content: Mia was diagnosed with a peanut allergy last year, so we keep the house peanut-free. Can you suggest a few school lunch ideas for her?

Of course. Keeping everything peanut-free, here are three lunch ideas: turkey and cheese roll-ups with apple slices, a sunflower-seed-butter and jam sandwich, and pasta salad with cherry tomatoes and mozzarella.
She also refuses anything with mushrooms, so leave those out too.
Noted: no peanuts and no mushrooms. I will keep both out of every suggestion for Mia.
Mia turns 7 in January and she is obsessed with dinosaurs right now. Any ideas for her birthday party?
A dinosaur dig party would suit her: bury toy fossils in a sandbox, serve food with dinosaur names, and give each guest a small explorer hat.
We usually host family gatherings at our place on Saturdays. My sister brings her twins, who are vegetarian.
Good to know. For Saturday gatherings I will plan dishes that work for the vegetarian twins as well as everyone else.
